label: Rule metadata extraction
description: What is read from a rule's own text into its References and Other metadata (kept in sync on every change of the rule; existing rules: Admin → Bulk parse fields → References & metadata). reference_keys = keys whose values are references (YARA meta, Sigma / YAML keys, Elastic, KQL header comments…). skip_keys = keys never shown as other metadata: Rulezet already has them as fields, or they are the rule's logic. Limits keep one rule's JSON small. long_text_keys = keys kept whole, line breaks included, up to long_text_max_length characters (a list becomes a Markdown bullet list): Elastic note (investigation guide) and setup, Splunk how_to_implement and known_false_positives, false positives written as sentences… — shown as collapsible Markdown blocks. structured_keys = keys whose value is structured data (osquery queries, investigation fields, test cases, drill-down searches, compliance mappings…), kept as indented JSON up to structured_max_length characters and shown as a collapsible code block. extract_paths = per format, nested values to read too: {"dotted.path": "key"} (e.g. Elastic transform.osquery → osquery, Sigma logsource.definition → logsource_definition). platform_hint_keys = keys read only to find the rule's platforms, never shown (they are Rulezet fields, e.g. tags: Kunai os:linux, Elastic "OS: Windows" / "Data Source: AWS").
